map.糖质量分数 f = 糖 : 水 ÷ (糖 : 水 + 1)；白糖 = 糖浆总重量: Sugar mass fraction f = sugar : water ÷ (sugar : water + 1); sugar = total syrup weight × f; water = total syrup weight − sugar
map.糖水比按重量计，例如 2:1 表示 2 kg 白糖配 1 kg 水。糖浆密度随浓: Ratio is by weight: 2:1 means 2 kg sugar to 1 kg water. Syrup density rises with concentration; the tool estimates density from sugar mass fraction and converts to total weight. Feeding days are estimated from daily consumption per colony.
map.按糖浆密度估算，实际配料请以称重为准；表中为每 10 L 糖浆的近似用量。: Estimated from syrup density; weigh ingredients for actual mixing. Values are approximate amounts per 10 L of syrup.
map.糖水比按重量计，2:1 是常见越冬浓度；1:1 偏稀，适合弱群或奖励饲喂，但越冬: Ratio is by weight. 2:1 is a common winter concentration; 1:1 is thinner and suits weak colonies or stimulative feeding, but has more water and ferments more easily in winter.
map.糖浆密度随糖浓度升高，工具按糖质量分数估算；实际配料建议用秤称白糖和水，不要只凭: Syrup density rises with sugar concentration and is estimated from sugar mass fraction. Weigh sugar and water for actual mixing rather than estimating by volume.
map.饲喂天数 = 每群补饲量 ÷ 每群每日消耗量；实际采食受温度、群势与蜂箱位置影响: Feeding days = syrup per colony ÷ daily consumption per colony. Actual intake depends on temperature, colony strength and hive position; feed in 2-3 smaller portions.
map.不要用红糖、蜂蜜或含添加剂的糖浆喂蜂；糖浆温度控制在 30–35 ℃，避免烫伤蜜: Do not feed bees brown sugar, honey or syrup with additives. Keep syrup at 30-35 °C to avoid scalding bees and triggering robbing.
map.结果为配料与成本估算，具体补饲量应结合群势、蜜脾储备与当地越冬期长度调整。: Results are ingredient and cost estimates. Adjust the actual feed amount to colony strength, honey stores and local winter length.

map.越冬饲料备料：按蜂群数量和每群补饲量，一次算出白糖、加水与总成本，避免买到一半才: Winter feed preparation: calculate sugar, water and total cost from colony count and feed volume in one pass, so you do not run short halfway through.
map.弱群复壮：弱群用 1:1 稀糖浆少量多次奖励饲喂，促进产卵与造脾，但要注意防盗蜂: Weak colony build-up: feed 1:1 thin syrup in small, repeated portions to encourage laying and comb building, while guarding against robbing.
map.饲喂计划安排：按每日消耗量估算几天喂完，把补饲安排在晴暖午后，避免低温期糖浆积在: Feeding schedule: estimate how many days the feed will last from daily intake, and feed on mild sunny afternoons so syrup does not accumulate at the hive bottom in cold weather.
map.算例：10 群、每群 6 L、糖水比 2:1: Example: 10 colonies, 6 L per colony, 2:1 ratio
Sugar mass fraction = 2 ÷ (2 + 1) = 66.7%. At 2:1, syrup density is about 1.34 kg/L; total syrup weight = 10 × 6 × 1.34 = 80.4 kg; sugar = 80.4 × 66.7% = 53.6 kg; water = 26.8 kg. At CNY 6/kg, cost is about CNY 322. At 0.4 L per colony per day, the feed lasts about 15 days; feed in 3 portions of 2 L.
map.越冬糖浆为什么常用 2:1？: Why is 2:1 common for winter syrup?
map.2:1（糖:水，按重量）糖分高、水分少，蜜蜂酿制负担小，低温下不易发酵，是多数地: At 2:1 (sugar:water by weight), sugar content is high and water low, so bees spend less effort ripening it and it ferments less at low temperatures. It is a common winter feed in many regions, but local climate and colony strength still matter.
map.不是。超过约 2.5:1 时糖浆黏度高、冷却后易结晶，蜜蜂取食困难，还可能刺激盗: No. Above about 2.5:1, syrup becomes viscous, crystallizes as it cools and is hard for bees to take, and may also trigger robbing. Keep winter feed at or below 2.5:1 and adjust with temperature.
map.能不能用红糖或蜂蜜喂蜂？: Can I feed bees brown sugar or honey?
map.不建议。红糖含杂质和矿物质，易引起消化不良；来源不明的蜂蜜可能带入病原，且高温处: Not recommended. Brown sugar contains impurities and minerals that can cause digestive problems; honey of unknown origin may carry pathogens, and heat treatment damages nutrients. Use clean white sugar and water for winter feed.
map.饲喂天数怎么定？: How should I set the feeding days?
map.按每群每日消耗量和补饲总量估算，再结合天气分次投喂。低温阴雨、蜂群结团时采食量下: Estimate from daily consumption per colony and the total feed, then split feeding around the weather. Intake drops in cold rain and when the cluster is tight; check honey stores early so leftover syrup does not ferment.
